mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the coronary vessels was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway distinguishes the heart muscle’s own blood supply from blood in its chambers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the pulmonary and systemic routes was straightforward, though the separate steps helped establish the two-loop layout.

surprise.text: I expected to add blood immediately, but the coronary connection had to be made first. The result explained why the pump itself needs a supply.

arbitrary.text: The required order of coronary vessels before blood was not obvious from the goal, although compatibility feedback made the next action automatic and its purpose was explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the valve timing and the heart’s own blood supply made the construction informative, even if some connections were predictable.
